# client-properties

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/client-properties.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `client-properties` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.clientregistration`: generated from its catalogue, client-properties.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH` (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` (extended property) | Unset; one of `registered`, `auto_registered` | Who registered the client: registered (12.2 explicit) or auto_registered (12.1); a client without it was created by an administrator, and neither registration path touches it | **Per request**: Not declared in PingFederate: the registration is refused and the client disabled | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain` (extended property) | Unset | The trust chain the client was registered with | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `application_type` (extended property) | Unset | application_type from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `subject_type` (extended property) | Unset | subject_type from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `contacts` (extended property) | Unset | contacts from the client's metadata | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `attestation_required` (extended property) | `false` | Written true when the client's metadata asks for client attestation. true: the client authenticates at the token endpoint only with an attestation, and a request for it without the OAuth-Client-Attestation header is refused (401 invalid_client) by the token-endpoint filter, which used to pass it to PingFederate's own client authentication | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning) | Any | Yes |
| `federation_registration_expires_at` (extended property) | Unset; a whole number, at least 0 | When the registration ends, in epoch seconds: never later than its trust chain (12.3) | **Per request**: Written by this module; a value that is not a whole number is read, with a warning, as no expiry | Any | Yes |
| `federation_trust_anchor` (extended property) | Unset | The trust anchor the registration's chain reached; the token-issuance decision is asked with it | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | Yes |
| `federation_entity_type` (extended property) | Unset; one of `openid_relying_party`, `oauth_client` | The Entity Type the client was registered from | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | No |
| `federation_registration_disabled_at` (extended property) | Unset; a whole number, at least 0 | When this module disabled the client because its registration expired, in epoch seconds; only a client carrying it is enabled again by a renewal | **Not checked**: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_pop_max_age` (extended property) | `300`; seconds, at least 1 | The oldest a client attestation's proof of possession may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_dpop_max_age` (extended property) | `300`; seconds, at least 1 | The oldest a DPoP proof presented with an attestation may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_clock_skew` (extended property) | `60`; a whole number, at least 0 | The clock skew allowed when checking this client's attestation, in seconds. Can only tighten the server's 60 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, negative, or more than the server's | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_challenge_required` (extended property) | `false` | Whether this client's attestation proof must carry a server-issued challenge. Can only tighten the server's policy (challenges optional): true requires one, false changes nothing | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning) | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_single_use` (extended property) | `false` | Whether each of this client's attestations authenticates once only, so every request needs a fresh attestation from the attester (refused use_fresh_attestation, 401, on a second presentation). Can only tighten the server's policy (OIDF_ATTESTATION_SINGLE_USE): true turns it on for this client, false changes nothing. Each token then costs an issuance call to the attester (OIDF_ATTESTER_ISSUANCE_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE) | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning) | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_revocation_mode` (extended property) | Unset; one of `live`, `status_list`, `both` | Whether this client's instances are checked with a stricter rule than the server's (plan items X-E11, X-E12): live checks each attestation's agent_id against the instance and agent registers and refuses, besides a suspended or revoked instance, an attestation whose agent_id no register knows and one without agent_id; status_list reads each attestation's status claim (draft-ietf-oauth-status-list-21) from the attester's Token Status List and refuses an entry that is not VALID and an attestation without the claim; both does both (401 invalid_client). Can only tighten OIDF_CLIENT_REVOCATION_MODE: a value turns its check on for this client whatever the server's mode; unset follows the server | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): off (it would loosen the server's mode), or any value other than live, status_list or both. status_list for a client whose attester mints no status claim: every attestation it presents is refused | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_refresh_binding` (extended property) | Unset; one of `on`, `strict` | How this client's refresh tokens are bound to the client instance key (ABCA-11 §10.3, plan item X-E15). Can only tighten OIDF_ATTESTATION_REFRESH_BINDING: on binds them even when the server's setting is off; strict also refuses a refresh token with no binding recorded (400 invalid_grant), for a client whose every refresh token was issued since 0.8.0. Unset follows the server | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): off (it would loosen the server's setting), or any other value | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_expected_htu` (extended property) | Unset | A pin of the htu a DPoP proof names at the token endpoint. Can only pin: it must be the token endpoint's URL as PingFederate advertises it (its token endpoint base URL, else its issuer, then /as/token.oauth2) or the issuer followed by /as/token.oauth2 | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not an absolute http or https URL without query or fragment, or a URL this server does not answer at for the token endpoint | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_accepted_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_pop_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What this client's attestation proof may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_dpop_algs` (extended property) | `RS256,RS384,RS512,PS256,PS384,PS512,ES256,ES384,ES512,EdDSA`; a list | What a DPoP proof with this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_required_claims` (extended property) | Unset; a list | Top-level claims this client's attestation must carry, comma-separated. Can only add to the claims every client's attestation must carry (oidf.attestation.required.claims or OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS). workload, authorization_details and agent_id keep their checks; any other name must be present with a value other than null (until 0.8.0 any other name passed unchecked) | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): a list of nothing; a claim the attester does not send, a misspelling included, refuses every attestation with insufficient_disclosure | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_accepted_typs` (extended property) | `oauth-client-attestation+jwt`; a list | The attestation typ values this client's attestation may carry, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (OIDF_ATTESTATION_ACCEPTED_TYPS, by default oauth-client-attestation+jwt alone): the values kept are those in both. Lets one client be held to a profile's typ (draft-ietf-oauth-attestation-based-client-auth-11 §4, §13) once the server accepts it | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_min_key_storage` (extended property) | Unset; one of `iso_18045_basic`, `iso_18045_enhanced-basic`, `iso_18045_moderate`, `iso_18045_high` | The lowest key_storage level this client's attestation must assert (OpenID4VCI 1.0 Appendix D.2), compared on ISO/IEC 18045 attack potential: basic < enhanced-basic < moderate < high. An attestation below it, without the claim, or asserting a value outside the four is refused invalid_client_attestation (401). Can only raise the server's minimum (OIDF_ATTESTATION_MIN_KEY_STORAGE) | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not one of the four levels spelt exactly, or below the server's minimum | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_min_user_authentication` (extended property) | Unset; one of `iso_18045_basic`, `iso_18045_enhanced-basic`, `iso_18045_moderate`, `iso_18045_high` | The lowest user_authentication level this client's attestation must assert (OpenID4VCI 1.0 Appendix D.2), compared on ISO/IEC 18045 attack potential: basic < enhanced-basic < moderate < high. An attestation below it, without the claim, or asserting a value outside the four is refused invalid_client_attestation (401). Can only raise the server's minimum (OIDF_ATTESTATION_MIN_USER_AUTHENTICATION) | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not one of the four levels spelt exactly, or below the server's minimum | Any | Yes |
| `attestation_required_trust_marks` (extended property) | Unset; a list | The OpenID Federation Trust Mark types this client's attester must hold, space- or comma-separated (plan item X-E07). Can only add to the server's list (OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_TRUST_MARKS): the client is held to the types of both, so it can never drop a mark the deployment requires. The attester is refused invalid_client_attestation (401) unless its Entity Configuration carries a valid mark of each type against the chain's Trust Anchor (OpenID Federation 1.0 §7.3); a statically trusted attester (oidf.mock.attesters) holds none, so any requirement refuses it | **Per request**: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): a list of nothing, more than one value, or a padded value; a type the attester does not hold, a misspelling included, refuses every attestation with invalid_client_attestation | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_leaf_max_time` (extended property) | `-1`; a whole number | The longest the leaf's Entity Configuration in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_trustanchor_max_time` (extended property) | `-1`; a whole number | The longest the trust anchor's statement in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `trust_chain_request_max_age` (extended property) | `60`; a whole number | The oldest a statement in a presented chain may be, in seconds, before it is fetched again; -1 is no limit. From 0.6.0 one default, 60, for every reader: the OGNL chain criterion, and the attester's chain at the attestation criterion and the token-endpoint filter, which used -1 before (F-0198) | **Per request**: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `federation_pdp_token_issuance` (extended property) | `false` | Whether the policy decision point is asked about this client's tokens even when OIDF_PDP_DECISION_POINTS does not list token_issuance. Can only tighten: true asks, false changes nothing. Needs OIDF_PDP_MODE=authzen. Set by the operator in PingFederate, never taken from a relying party's metadata, and kept when its registration renews | **Per request**: Every token for the client is refused (federation.pdp.client_policy_invalid): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded, or true without OIDF_PDP_MODE=authzen | Any | Yes |
| `federation_pdp_fail_open` (extended property) | Unset; one of `false` | Set to false to make this client fail closed when the deployment fails open (OIDF_PDP_FAIL_OPEN=true): a token the policy decision point gave no answer about is refused. Only false means anything; a property may not loosen the deployment's setting. Set by the operator in PingFederate, never taken from a relying party's metadata, and kept when its registration renews | **Per request**: Every token for the client is refused (federation.pdp.client_policy_invalid): true, or anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded | Any | Yes |
